claims.title: Concrete compare-exchange collision

source_refs.excerpt: U_ij alone is noninjective. The lift x↦(U_ij(x),c_ij(x)) is injective: its left inverse leaves the output unchanged when c=0 and swaps coordinates i,j back when c=1.
For declared compare-exchange Uᵢⱼ and cᵢⱼ(x)=1[xᵢ<xⱼ], enumerate the two-point collision

assumptions: One-step Nat-pair compare-exchange using the strict less-than branch, with its Boolean action bit and the specified swap-back decoder.
claims.countercase: The finite Nat fixture (0,1) and (1,0) collides under this declared exchange.
claims.authority_ceiling: Finite countermodel to injectivity of this declared map only; no claim about sorting, persistence, or PAL adoption.
claims.residual: Comparator and coordinate semantics are fixed to this Lean definition.
claims.reopening: Change the exchange rule, pair domain, or requested property.

exhibit an update collision, prove the action-bit lift injective by explicit left inverse

assumptions: One-step Nat-pair compare-exchange using the strict less-than branch, with its Boolean action bit and the specified swap-back decoder.

claims.title: Uniqueness of a reachable decoder
claims.statement: ∀ {W T Q} (trace : W → T) (answer : W → Q) (decode₁ decode₂ : Set.range trace → Q), (∀ w, decode₁ ⟨trace w, ⟨w, rfl⟩⟩ = answer w) → (∀ w, decode₂ ⟨trace w, ⟨w, rfl⟩⟩ = answer w) → decode₁ = decode₂

source_refs.excerpt: Exactly when L(τ,q)=∅, q factors uniquely as d_R∘τ through a decoder d_R:R→Q. Extension of d_R to all T is a separate totalization claim.
L(τ,q)=∅ exactly when a unique d_R:R→Q satisfies q=d_R∘τ on W.

assumptions: Lean types W, T, Q and supplied total functions trace and answer.
Both decoders are defined on Set.range trace and satisfy the same answer equation for every source element.
claims.countercase: A conflicting trace collision prevents any decoder satisfying the same answer equation; this theorem assumes two such decoders exist.
claims.authority_ceiling: Set-theoretic uniqueness on Set.range trace only; no extension to all T and no regularity, implementation, permission, or authority claim.
claims.residual: Existence, totalization, and decoder classes remain separately scoped.
claims.reopening: Change W, T, Q, trace, answer, or decoder domain/class.
